question: Does swapping the order of an addressed shortest lawful change and ordinary growth generate distinguishable signs and indistinguishable ordinary local reads?
forbidden_inputs: No preparation label, copy of the initial word, schedule, outcome selection, assigned phase or quantum operator goes to the reader. Fix the physical parity read and held-out size before evaluation.
primary_observable: Sign on the originally shared distinctions, equality of local joint distributions, least detecting support, and equality or distinguishability of full words.
cheapest_meaningful_control: Offer the allowed change of the entire old odd set with a fair coin, or prepare the full source uniformly. Test a common later one-mark read.
first_executable_signal: Compare one minimum-change request just before and just after the actual first funded growth, from the same blank source.
resource_budget: Five source knots with 32768 grown words, and ranks at seven and at two further rounds capped at 150 holdings, below 512 MiB per process.
stop_rule: Record both arms, verified limits of the ordinary read comparison, independent size check, controls, and any later single-mark decoder on the registered growth rounds.
decision_or_followup_rule: Distinguish an ordinary conserved preparation record from a quantum relative phase. Reopen the stronger question only with a concrete new preparation, source of phase or different physical readout.
nonclaims: No extraction of quantum amplitudes, no implication for all logical systems, and no inference of an autonomous clock, probability rule or physical space.
